caveats: The top-floor round-arched arcade with tile mosaic named in the RCE text is not modelled (not visible in any panorama frame).
Pilasters and plinth detail are simplified (no capitals, no rustication); frieze pattern is a plain band.
The 1970 wing's later cladding is drawn with the same grid as the 1950s slab.
